They are in the same folder as the CSV file.

import re

def desc_to_slug(d):
    s = d.lower().strip()
    s = s.replace('-', ' ')
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]+', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', '_', s)
    return s

pdf_base_map={os.path.basename(p).lower():p for p in pdfs}
pdf_bases=[os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0].lower() for p in pdfs]
print('pdf_bases', pdf_bases)

receipt_map={}
for item in parsed:
    slug=desc_to_slug(item['description'])
    # exact match on base name
    matches=[p for p in pdfs if os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0].lower()==slug]
    if not matches:
        # substring match as fallback (still derived from file names)
        matches=[p for p in pdfs if slug in os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(p))[0].lower()]
    receipt_map[item['email']]=matches
    print('desc', item['description'], 'slug', slug, 'matches', matches)

# Execute Venmo and Splitwise actions based on parsed owe_list and venmo search results

my_email = 'lindseysimpson@gmail.com'

# Prepare results containers
venmo_actions=[]
splitwise_actions=[]

# Helper for receipt path for Splitwise expenses
# receipt_map: email -> list of matching pdf paths

def pick_receipt_path(email, description):
    matches = receipt_map.get(email, [])
    if matches:
        return matches[0]
    return None

for entry in parsed:
    email = entry['email']
    amount = entry['amount']
    desc = entry['description']

    if venmo_found.get(email, False):
        print(f"Venmo: attempting send to {email} amount {amount} desc {desc}")
        venmo_resp = apis.venmo.create_transaction(
            access_token=venmo_token,
            receiver_email=email,
            amount=amount,
            description=desc,
            private=True
        )
        print(' venmo_resp', venmo_resp)
        venmo_actions.append({'email': email, 'amount': amount, 'description': desc, 'resp': venmo_resp})
    else:
        receipt_path = pick_receipt_path(email, desc)
        print(f"Splitwise: creating expense for {email} amount {amount} desc {desc} receipt {receipt_path}")
        if not receipt_path:
            raise Exception(f"Missing receipt for {email} / {desc}")
        split_resp = apis.splitwise.record_expense(
            access_token=splitwise_token,
            description=desc,
            paid_amount=amount,
            payer_email=my_email,
            debtor_emails=[email],
            receipt_file_path=receipt_path,
            file_system_access_token=fs_token
